subject.type: anthropomorphic figure (animal head + tailored human body) — match the proportions of a real adult human male portrait
subject.head_sizing_CRITICAL: the bull head MUST be sized to fit a human body's proportions — approximately the size of a normal adult human head, NOT a real bull's anatomically full head size. Bull heads are 4-5x larger than human heads in real life; we are NOT rendering it at that scale. The head should occupy roughly 25-30% of the total frame height, with shoulders and torso filling the remaining 60-70%. Imagine a normal human gentleman's portrait — the head takes up the top quarter of the frame, not over half. The fox-on-suit reference image is the correct head-to-body ratio. The head should look like it BELONGS on that body, anatomically scaled like a human head.
subject.head_features: anatomically correct bull head proportions (Hereford/Angus reference) but SIZED DOWN to human-head scale. Coarse short-hair coat in mahogany-and-chestnut with realistic individual hair definition. Wet velvet-black nose with realistic catchlights. Small bovine eyes with warm amber iris and soft inner catchlight (bovine eyes are anatomically smaller than human eyes in proportion to the skull — keep them small). Mouth closed, neutral. Short tufted forelock between horns. Horns: dark polished, moderate length, ivory at base graduating to near-black tips, scaled to the smaller head proportionally. Alert ears angled slightly outward.
